text: Seafrigo Investissements, a Le Havre SAS holding company (RCS Le Havre 909 922 965), is president of Seafrigo group companies including Seafrigo Logistique and Seafrigo Transports; its president is Eric Barbe, who created Seafrigo in Le Havre more than 40 years ago.
short: Seafrigo's companies are chaired by holding company Seafrigo Investissements (president Eric Barbe).

additionalSources.name: AJOT: Seafrigo becomes Principal Partner of Le Havre Athletic Club
additionalSources.quote: Seafrigo was created in Le Havre more than 40 years ago by Éric Barbé, and is deeply rooted in its home territory.
